inv.desc_en:
Are you a beauty professional looking for a space to serve your clients with style and tranquility?
At IKI, a beauty salon with sophisticated and zen aesthetics, we have spaces ready to work.
✨ AVAILABLE OPTIONS: ? ♀️ Hairdressing vanity station
— €500/month
— Includes individual vanity, backlit mirror, professional chair and space for your tools.
— Well-maintained environment, warm lighting and elegant surroundings. ? Manicure and pedicure area
— €350/month
— Equipped manicure table and pedicure chair with relaxing aesthetics.
— Perfect for manicurists or hand/foot nail and beauty specialists. ? Also includes:
Use of common areas (bathroom, reception, waiting room).
Air conditioning.
Cleaning of common areas. ? Location: Calle Ferraz (Argüelles area – Madrid).
